summary: Barclays PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting. All 24 resolutions, including the receipt of reports, reappointment of directors and auditors, approval of remuneration, authorization to allot shares, purchase own shares, and make political donations, were passed with large majorities. The filing discloses voting tallies, percentages, and shareholder participation rates. This is a routine disclosure of a standard AGM outcome with no special situation event. No deal terms, activist involvement, or strategic corporate action is present.
